corpus: fixtures: game-rtti-o2, game-rtti-o0, game-nortti-o2 (real linked ARM64 ELF, RTTI present / RTTI absent)

capabilities.evidence: createCppReceiverEvidence enforces a non-static-member proof and fails closed, but extractCppObjectEvidence has no production caller; no receiver is derived from a real binary in the pipeline.
findCxxClasses requires _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS symbols. Measured: 8 named classes per fixture, including 3 __cxxabiv1 implementation classes; nothing is discoverable without those symbols.
readVtable with a fixed cap enumerated 64 slots across 8 symbol-derived tables that hold 20; 12 of the enumerated entries resolve to _ZTI/_ZTV/_ZTS symbols, i.e. provably not methods.
_ZTI addresses were used as labels only; no typeinfo record was parsed, so the ABI kind and base arrays were unread.
Names came from demangling _ZTV/_ZTS symbols. A stripped-but-RTTI binary yielded no names even though the type-name string was present.

No __si_class_type_info / __vmi_class_type_info base array was read; AFTER: 4 edges per RTTI fixture (including a __vmi class with two bases at subobject offsets 0 and 24), 0 for the -fno-rtti fixture.
No derived-class enumeration existed; AFTER: derivedClassesOf returns transitive RTTI-proven derived classes only.
Slot addresses resolved, but identical-code folding merged three destructors onto one address and the single-name projection attributed the slot to one arbitrary class.

No call-site-scoped target set existed. AFTER: 20 target sets on the RTTI fixtures (9-10 multi-candidate) and 19 on the -fno-rtti fixture (0 multi-candidate), with 0 closure claims without an explicit call-site authority.
Recognised only from symbol syntax (C1/C2/D0/D1/D2); not used as a receiver or dynamic-type proof.
fieldFor hooks plus js/decompiler/types/layout.js already recover offsets, widths and array shape.
Width only (layout.js size). AFTER: float/double/pointer/bool-like/array-like plus signed byte/halfword/word/doubleword categories, with width-only integers left explicitly unclaimed.
js/analysis/types/constraints.js exists but was not connected to member categories; AFTER: an 8-byte member used as an address or argument is reported as a pointer with a rule string.

unsafeToInfer: class names without RTTI symbols or a type-name string
inheritance edges without a readable typeinfo base array
slot targets beyond a proven vtable extent
a single virtual target from a single discovered candidate
signedness of a plain (non sign-extending) word/byte access
encoded pointer words reinterpreted as addresses without fixup context
